Need K2:K6 formula returning header of column among B,D,F,H whose date equals J? "earliest activity number" maybe header Activity 1/2/3/4. If match found in Col B, populate col K with that header (Activity 1 is header for Col B). So K should be B1, D1, F1, H1 corresponding to earliest date. Need handle ties? J is MIN of C,E,G,I. If multiple equal earliest, which? Could return first? Need likely use INDEX/MATCH: =INDEX($B$1:$H$1, MATCH(J2, C2:I2, 0)*2 -1?) But B1:H1 includes B,C,D,E,F,G,H,I? Actually B1:H1 = Activity1, Activity1 Date, Activity2, Activity2 Date, Activity3, Activity3 Date, Activity4. Need return B1,D1,F1,H1. Could use =INDEX($B$1:$H$1, MATCH(J2, C2:I2, 0)*2 -1) because C2:I2 positions 1..8? Wait C2:I2 is 7 cells: C,D,E,F,G,H,I. But date cells are C,E,G,I. MATCH(J2, C2:I2,0) returns position among C..I. If match at C (pos1) -> B1 index? B1:H1 index 1. pos1*2-1=1. If match at E (pos3) -> D1 index 3. pos3*2-1=5? No B1:H1 indices: 1 B,2 C,3 D,4 E,5 F,6 G,7 H. Need D1 index 3. pos3? formula pos? If match in C2:I2: C pos1 -> B index1; E pos3 -> D index3; G pos5 -> F index5; I pos7 -> H index7. So index = MATCH(J2, C2:I2,0). Because C2:I2 positions align with B1:H1? C pos1 -> B1 index1, D pos2 (not date) but no match, E pos3 -> D1 index3, F pos4 no, G pos5 -> F1 index5, H pos6 no, I pos7 -> H1 index7. Yes =INDEX($B$1:$H$1, MATCH(J2, C2:I2, 0)). But if J is blank? J formula MIN of blanks? If all blank, MIN returns 0? Actually MIN of empty cells returns 0. J2 for row 2 has values. Row 3 only B? J3 cached 2009-01-16. Row 4 B,D. Row 5 B,D,F,H. Row 6 B,D. All have at least one. But if no match due to floating? Dates are serial numbers. J = VALUE(MIN(...)) maybe numeric. C/E/G/I are VALUE(...) numeric. MATCH exact should work.

But need consider J formula uses MIN(C,E,G,I) where blanks? If blank, MIN ignores blanks? MIN of empty cells? If all empty, 0. If some empty, ignores. Good.

Could use =INDEX($B$1:$H$1,MATCH(J2,C2:I2,0)). Fill K2:K6.

Need ensure formula self-contained. Use fill_formula with top-left K2 formula =INDEX($B$1:$H$1,MATCH(J2,C2:I2,0)). Range K2:K6. This will translate J2 to J3 etc, C2:I2 to C3:I3. Good.

But check if MATCH over C2:I2 includes text columns D,F,H? They contain text like "11/05/1999 -WoodWork - Saturn". J numeric. Exact match won't match text. Good.

Potential issue: C2:I2 includes C2 formula returns date serial, D2 text, E2 date, F2 text, G2 date, H2 text, I2 date. If J2 equals a date in C/E/G/I. Good.

But if earliest date appears in multiple activities, MATCH returns first (leftmost) among C,E,G,I. That's reasonable.

Need maybe return "Activity 1" header from B1, D1, F1, H1. B1:H1 includes headers and date headers. If match at C pos1 returns B1 "Activity 1". If match at E pos3 returns D1 "Activity 2". If match at G pos5 returns F1 "Activity 3". If match at I pos7 returns H1 "Activity 4". Good.

Could also use =INDEX($B$1:$H$1,MATCH(J2,CHOOSE({1,3,5,7},C2,E2,G2,I2),0)*2-1) but not needed.

Need output JSON only. route operations, summary, operations one fill_formula. Ensure no markdown.

Double-check schema: operations array min 1 max 128. FillFormula properties op, sheet, range, formula. formula top-left. Good.

Need maybe include style? No.

Need consider answer ranges K2:K6 only. Destination wholly inside. Good.

Need maybe use set_formula for each? fill_formula okay.

Need ensure formula uses English names. INDEX, MATCH classic.

Potential hidden issue: J2 formula =VALUE(MIN(C2,E2,G2,I2)). If C/E/G/I are formulas returning "" for blank? Actually IFERROR(VALUE(REPLACE(...)),"") returns "" if blank? If cell blank, REPLACE("",11,500,"") returns ""? VALUE("") error? IFERROR returns "". So date columns can be empty string. MIN ignores text? MIN ignores text and logical values in references? Yes MIN ignores text in cells? In Excel, MIN ignores text and logical values in cells? It ignores text in cells? I think MIN ignores text in cells and empty cells. If all text/empty, returns 0. J numeric. MATCH exact numeric. Good.

But if J is 0 and no date 0, MATCH error. Not in data. Could wrap IFERROR to blank? Not necessary but maybe robust. If no activity, K blank. Need think if MATCH(J2,C2:I2,0) when J2 is 0 and C2:I2 contains empty strings? It won't match. IFERROR blank. Good.

Could there be a date 0? No.

Need maybe use absolute header row $B$1:$H$1. Good.
